nodes.description: Address of the current owner of the contract; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed/cleared by acceptOwnership (two-step ownership handover).
Public token symbol string, set to "XVR" in the Visor constructor.
Public token name string, set to "Visor" in the Visor constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the Visor constructor.
Total token supply (100000000 * 10**18), assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated by the constructor, transfer, transferFrom and read by balanceOf/totalSupply.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) ERC20 allowance table; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Checked addition helper: c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Checked subtraction helper: require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
Checked multiplication helper: c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
Checked division helper: require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Abstract ERC20 totalSupply declaration.
Abstract ERC20 balanceOf declaration.
Abstract ERC20 allowance declaration.
Abstract ERC20 transfer declaration; invoked through an external call in transferAnyERC20Token.
Abstract ERC20 approve declaration.
Abstract ERC20 transferFrom declaration.
Abstract callback executed by the spender contract when approveAndCall is used; the external call target controlled by the caller.
Owned constructor, assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function storing _newOwner in newOwner for the two-step ownership transfer.
Completes ownership transfer when msg.sender == newOwner, then clears newOwner to address(0).
Visor constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints total supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the SafeMath helpers.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then performs an external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) - external contract executes arbitrary code.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, so the contract never accepts ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that performs an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens held by this contract to the owner.
Caller-supplied address used for ownership checks, balance/allowance mutation and as the 'from' value of the approveAndCall callback.
Arithmetic addition c = a + b inside SafeMath.safeAdd, followed by an overflow require(c >= a).
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b inside SafeMath.safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b inside SafeMath.safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic division c = a / b inside SafeMath.safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed inside approveAndCall; the callee is fully attacker controlled.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) executed inside the onlyOwner rescue function.

safeAdd contains the checked addition operation; require(c >= a) guards overflow.

Owned constructor assigns owner from the caller-supplied msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the caller-controlled address.
approve keys the allowance table on msg.sender.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address.
approveAndCall forwards msg.sender as the 'from' argument to the attacker-controlled callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Visor constructor initialises the symbol state variable.
Visor constructor initialises the name state variable.
Visor constructor initialises the decimals state variable.
Visor constructor mints the fixed total supply into _totalSupply.
Visor constructor writes the whole supply into balances of the fixed holder.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates the sender and recipient balances mapping entries.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry for (msg.sender, spender).
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry of the spender.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub twice (balance and allowance).
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before calling out.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call which may re-enter the token.
External call invokes the attacker-supplied spender contract implementation of receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer call.
External call dispatches into the callee token contract's transfer function.
